agents.docs.step3: 3. Send the edits as a batch — in every `element.create` give `"folder":{folder}`:
agents.docs.step4: 4. The preparation for the run is done by `begin` itself; `run.prepare` only if the person asks to clear the canvas.
agents.docs.step5: 5. Check: the scheme as text — `{scheme}`, the pre-check — `{check}`.
agents.docs.step6: 6. Tell the person what was done.
